CFML Language Reference: Functions

CompareNoCase

Compares two strings without regard to upper or lower case and tells you which one sorts first.

Category

String functions

Syntax

CompareNoCase(string1, string2)

Parameters

string1
The first string.
string2
The second string.

Returns

-1 if string1 is less than string2, 0 if they are equal ignoring case, 1 if string1 is greater than string2.

Usage

This is the comparison behind the EQ, LT and GT operators when they compare strings. Use Compare when case matters.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Names = "smith,Smith,SMITH,Smythe">
<UL>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Names#" INDEX="n">
<CFOUTPUT><LI>CompareNoCase("Smith", "#n#") = #CompareNoCase("Smith", n)#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</UL>

See also

Compare, FindNoCase, ListSort
